title: Memoir '44 Sim scenario
description: A scenario for the m44-sim app: the map editor's maps and the catalog's files (src/data/catalog/<id>.json). Positions are { row, col } on the 13 × 9 board seen from the Allies' side (row 0 is the Axis' back row; odd rows have 12 hexes). The app checks the rules too (parseScenario in scenarioFile.ts): no unit on water, one unit per hex, and so on.

$schema.description: Where an editor finds this format; the app ignores it

board.description: The standard board: 13 hexes across, 9 rows

id.description: Lower-case words joined by hyphens; saves and the catalog find the scenario by it, and a catalog file is named after it

description.description: A few sentences shown in the menu

notes.description: Where the scenario comes from and the rulings made for it; not shown in the app

initialHandSize.description: Command cards each side starts with

attacker.description: The side that normally starts; it plays one extra turn before the defender joins in

tiles.description: The hexes of each terrain; a hex not listed is plains

units.description: Where each side's units start, by unit type

reinforcements.description: No longer used: the Reinforcements card's old table of a unit per die face (the card now always brings infantry). Older files still have it, and the app drops it

paradrop.description: Units one side drops on the table before the game starts; that side's app asks where they landed

wire.description: Hexes with barbed wire (not on water)

sandbags.description: Hexes whose unit starts with sandbags (either side's)

elite.description: Hexes whose unit starts as elite (either side's)

extraDraws.description: One side draws 2 command cards instead of 1 after each of its first turns

bigGuns.description: Sides that get Cortina de Fuego (Barrage); both when left out

airPower.description: Copies of each air card per side: one per air sortie, 0 against the enemy's air superiority; 1 each when left out

localized.description: A text in each language; an empty one shows the other
